title: Physical Function and Fall Risk in Older Adults in the Lalín Frailty Prevention Program
official: Observational Study of Frailty and Fall Risk in Older Adults Included in the Frailty and Falls Prevention Program at the Centro Integral de Saúde de Lalín
summary: This prospective observational study will describe changes in physical function and fall risk among adults aged 70 years or older who participate in the routine Frailty and Falls Prevention Program at the Centro Integral de Saúde de Lalín. Clinical assessments obtained before the program (T0) and at its completion (T1, approximately 8-12 weeks later) will be analyzed. The study does not assign treatment or change routine care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 70 years or older.
* Barthel Index score ≥90.
* Enrollment in the Lalín Frailty and Falls Prevention Program as part of routine clinical care.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical contraindication to physical activity.
* Inability to provide informed consent.
